findings.fix: Move the script command examples and the exit-code reading procedure into references/scripts.md. Load it from section 7 with one line: 'Read references/scripts.md only when the user wants a file written or supplies a run log.' That keeps the SKILL.md body in the Process pattern.

findings.evidence: Both script-run evals ('script-bug-file', 'script-test-case-file') attach logs with exit 0 only, so no output eval covers the exit 1 / 2 / 3 reviewer branches that section 7 step 1 spells out in detail
findings.fix: Add an eval with a run-log fixture in evals/files/ showing exit 3 (missing ./bugs). Assert three things: the reply reports the JSON 'error' verbatim, it proposes creating the directory or another writable destination without running anything, and it does not suggest --overwrite.

findings.evidence: Step 1 is one dense paragraph: 'Then read the exit code below, but as a reviewer ... On exit 0, steps 2.1-2.3 and 2.5 still apply; step 2.4's edits wait for that authorization. In every supplied-log reply, add one line on reading results...'. It nests cross-references to sub-steps, and line 127 'Reading the result, in this order:' has no blank line after the previous bullet, so it renders inside that bullet
findings.fix: Put a blank line before line 127. Split step 1 into its own checklist: (a) report the exit code and JSON verbatim; (b) list each logged flag against the source; (c) for exit 0, do 2.1-2.3 and 2.5 and hold the 2.4 edits until the user authorizes them; for exit 1/2/3, show the remedy without running it; (d) add the one-line exit-code reading guide.
